description: A script for fetching, parsing, and pretty-printing SSL/TLS certificates from various sources including files, server addresses, and network logs.

classes.name: ByteReader
classes.description: A class for sequentially reading bytes from a byte string, with methods to consume various data types and track position.

methods.name: read_file_to_string
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a byte string.

methods.name: read_certificates_data_from_server
methods.description: Uses openssl s_client to fetch PEM-encoded certificates from an SSL server.

methods.name: read_sources_from_commandline
methods.description: Processes command line arguments or stdin to gather source data.

methods.name: strip_indentation_whitespace
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from each line in a byte string.

methods.name: strip_all_whitespace
methods.description: Removes all whitespace characters from a byte string.

methods.name: extract_certificates_from_pem
methods.description: Extracts DER-encoded certificates from PEM data.

methods.name: extract_certificates_from_der_pkcs7
methods.description: Extracts certificates from DER-encoded PKCS7 data using openssl.

methods.name: extract_certificates_from_der_ascii
methods.description: Extracts DER certificates from ASCII DER representations.

methods.name: decode_netlog_hexdump
methods.description: Decodes a hexdump from network logs into raw bytes.

methods.name: decode_tls10_certificate_message
methods.description: Decodes TLS 1.0 certificate messages from a ByteReader.

methods.name: decode_tls13_certificate_message
methods.description: Decodes TLS 1.3 certificate messages from a ByteReader.

methods.name: decode_tls_certificate_message
methods.description: Decodes a TLS certificate message, trying both TLS 1.0 and 1.3 formats.

methods.name: extract_tls_certificate_message
methods.description: Extracts TLS certificate message from netlog text.

methods.name: extract_certificates
methods.description: Determines source data type and extracts certificates accordingly.

methods.name: process_data_with_command
methods.description: Runs a subprocess command with data piped to its stdin and returns its output.

methods.name: openssl_text_pretty_printer
methods.description: Uses openssl to produce a text dump of a DER certificate.

methods.name: pem_pretty_printer
methods.description: Converts DER certificate to PEM format using openssl.

methods.name: der2ascii_pretty_printer
methods.description: Converts DER certificate to ASCII representation using der2ascii.

methods.name: header_pretty_printer
methods.description: Creates a header string with certificate hash.

methods.name: der_printer
methods.description: Placeholder for DER output; raises error if used.

methods.name: pretty_print_certificates
methods.description: Formats DER certificates with specified pretty printers.

methods.name: parse_outputs
methods.description: Parses output format options into printer functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; processes sources and outputs formatted certificates.
